newsitem.title: USA: Ford, Citicorp cancel card program - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Ford, Citicorp cancel card program - WSJ.

text.p: Ford Motor Corp and Citicorp said they plan to discontinue their joint venture that gave holders of a Citibank credit card a rebate on every purchase that could be put toward buying a new car, the Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the Journal said that industry observers believe the deal could have been too successful -- and thus, too generous -- to keep.
As of last year, Ford had paid out rebates of more than $500 million to nearly 500,000 card holders, who received a five percent rebate on each purchase, according to RAM Research Group.
The credit-card industry research firm said Ford's potential liability, if all six million card holders redeemed their rebate dollars, was more than $4 billion.
"The consumer really got smart here a little too quickly," RAM Research President Robert McKinley said.
